items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And I used to like that Frankie Trumbauer and Tommy Dorsey and all them cats there.

ctx.x: Because they say that's where he got his kind of approach from.
Yeah. Him and Eddie Barefield, too. And I used to like that Frankie Trumbauer and Tommy Dorsey and all them cats there. Yeah. We studied with all that technical music.
What did you like about them?
